answer_1.quote: Relation Extraction (RE) is one of the most critical tasks in natural language processing... GRE uses a generative large language model (LLM) to extract relational triples from a source document D.

answer_2.quote: we introduce GENRES (GENerative Relation Extraction Scoring), a multi-dimensional framework tailored for evaluating GRE.

answer_3.quote: Within GENRES, we employ the GPT-3.5-Turbo-Instruct large language model (LLM) for assessing the factualness and granularity of extracted relationship triples.

answer_4.quote: We further conducted human evaluation experiments to verify the alignment of our proposed Gen-RES with human preferences. Three annotators, who are all computer science graduate students, are involved in this evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators should evaluate the outputs from five aspects in Section 3.
